settings.heading: Slow-made pottery, shaped by hand.
settings.subheading: A small neighbourhood studio offering wheel classes, open studio time and handmade tableware fired in our own kiln.

settings.heading: Classes & studio time
settings.intro: Small groups, patient teachers and all materials included.

blocks.title: Wheel taster
blocks.text: A relaxed two-hour introduction to throwing on the wheel. Leave with two glazed pieces.

blocks.title: Six-week course
blocks.text: Centre, throw, trim and glaze. Our most popular course for beginners.

blocks.title: Open studio
blocks.text: Monthly membership with shelf space, glazes and firing included.

blocks.title: Private sessions
blocks.text: One-to-one or small group sessions for couples, friends and teams.

settings.heading: Made a little imperfect, on purpose.
settings.text: Kiln & Clay started in a former bakery with one wheel and a second-hand kiln. Today we teach hundreds of people a year, yet every piece is still glazed and fired right here.

blocks.quote: The calmest two hours of my week. I came for a taster and stayed for a year.
blocks.author: Sofie L.

blocks.quote: Patient, funny teachers and the most beautiful glazes I have seen.
blocks.author: Tom V.

blocks.quote: We booked a private session for our team. Everyone still uses their mugs.
blocks.author: Lena K.

settings.heading: Questions or group bookings?
settings.text: Send us a note and we'll reply within one working day.

settings.tagline: A small ceramics studio for classes, open studio and handmade tableware.
